verdict.rationale: ClickUp's docs show the product has multiple configurable views of the same work, which can be created, grouped, sorted, and filtered at any level of the hierarchy (clickup-docs-33), and they mention distinct view types such as Chat views (clickup-docs-34). The evidence never names board, list, calendar, or timeline views, or describes switching between them in the UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Board, List, Calendar, and Timeline/Gantt view types, a description of switching between views on the same task set, and hands-on or community corroboration.
